note: Paddy needs nitrogen in 2-3 splits (tillering and panicle initiation), zinc on alkaline soils (khaira) and potash at panicle for grain weight. Excess urea invites BPH, blast and sheath blight.
Stem borer and leaf folder start early; BPH, sheath blight and blast peak at tillering to booting in humid weather; neck blast and false smut at heading.
Confirm with the farmer: dead hearts or white ears (stem borer), hopper burn circles (BPH), eye-shaped spots (blast), yellow drying from leaf tip (BLB).
Paddy tolerates standing water but suffers in long cloudy humid spells (blast, sheath blight) and heat at flowering (chaffy grains).
Critical weed-free period is the first 40 days after transplanting. Pre-emergence in 0-5 days, post-emergence at 15-25 DAT.
Wheat needs nitrogen at crown-root (20-25 DAS) and tillering, zinc on light soils, and potash spray at milk stage for grain filling.
Termite and aphid early; yellow rust in foggy Jan-Feb; aphid peaks at earhead emergence.
Look for yellow powder stripes (yellow rust), aphid colonies on ears, and wilting plants that pull out (termite).
Frost in Dec-Jan damages ears; terminal heat after mid-March shrivels grain - irrigate at milk and dough stages.
Gulli danda (Phalaris) and broad-leaf weeds; spray at 30-35 DAS after first irrigation.
Maize is a heavy nitrogen feeder: split urea at knee-high and tasselling; zinc deficiency shows as white stripes on young leaves.
Fall armyworm in the whorl from 10-40 DAS is the top threat; stem borer and termite early.
Ragged whorl leaves with sawdust frass = fall armyworm; dead heart = stem borer.
Waterlogging at knee-high stage and moisture stress at tasselling cut yield most.
Keep weed-free up to 40 DAS; atrazine pre-emergence or URUMI at 15-25 DAS.
Millets respond to moderate nitrogen and zinc; potash improves grain filling under dry conditions.
Shoot fly in late-sown crop, stem borer, and downy mildew / rust in humid weather.
Dead hearts in seedlings (shoot fly), whitish growth under leaves (downy mildew).
Drought tolerant but sensitive to waterlogging and heat at flowering.
Critical period 15-40 DAS; atrazine pre-emergence.
Pulses fix their own nitrogen: give phosphorus + sulphur at sowing, micronutrients before flowering and potash at pod filling. Avoid urea after establishment.
Whitefly spreads yellow mosaic early; pod borer at flowering; wilt and root rot in wet soil.
Yellow mosaic plants (uproot), holes in pods (pod borer), sudden wilting (wilt).
Flower drop in heat and cloudy weather; frost damages rabi pulses in Dec-Jan.
Pendimethalin pre-emergence; imazethapyr at 15-20 DAS.
Groundnut and soybean need gypsum / sulphur and calcium at pegging and pod filling; phosphorus at sowing.
Girdler beetle and spodoptera in soybean; tikka leaf spot and white grub in groundnut.
Ring cuts on stem (girdler beetle), skeletonised leaves (spodoptera), dark round spots with yellow halo (tikka).
Waterlogging causes root rot; dry spell at pod filling reduces yield.
Pendimethalin pre-emergence; imazethapyr at 15-20 DAS.
Mustard and sesame need sulphur for oil, boron at flowering and potash at seed filling.
Aphid in Dec-Feb is the main threat in mustard; alternaria and white rust in cloudy weather; sclerotinia at flowering.
Aphid colonies on flower heads, concentric-ring spots (alternaria), white blisters (white rust).
Frost and fog at flowering-pod stage; cloudy humid spells favour aphid and alternaria.
Pendimethalin pre-emergence and one hand weeding at 25-30 DAS.
Gourds need steady nitrogen for vines, phosphorus-potash at flowering, and calcium-boron for fruit set.
Fruit fly from first flowers, downy and powdery mildew in humid weather, whitefly carrying virus.
Rotting fruits with maggots (fruit fly), yellow angular patches (downy mildew), white powder (powdery mildew).
Heat causes flower drop and poor fruit set; heavy rain spreads downy mildew.
Weeds compete until vines cover the ground; pendimethalin pre-emergence and hand weeding.
Tomato, brinjal and chilli need split nitrogen, calcium-boron for fruit set and potash for fruit quality.
Sucking pests and leaf curl virus early; fruit and shoot borer from flowering; blights in humid weather.
Leaf curl (vector control), holes in fruits with frass (fruit borer), target spots (early blight).
Flower drop above 35°C; frost in Dec-Jan; fog triggers late blight in tomato.
Pendimethalin before transplanting; hoeing at 20-25 and 40-45 days.
Potato needs high potash for tuber size and nitrogen split at earthing up; calcium improves tuber quality.
Late blight in foggy Dec-Jan is the main risk; aphid spreads virus in seed crop.
Water-soaked dark patches spreading in days (late blight) - act within 24 hours.
Frost and fog in Dec-Jan: protect with irrigation and preventive fungicide.
Metribuzin or pendimethalin before emergence; earthing up controls later weeds.
Cabbage and cauliflower need nitrogen for head size, boron against hollow stem and browning, molybdenum on acid soils.
Diamondback moth and aphid; black rot in warm humid weather; damping off in nursery.
Window-pane holes (DBM), V-shaped yellow lesions from leaf edge (black rot).
Heat causes loose or buttoned heads; frost damages curds.
Pendimethalin before transplanting; hand weeding at 20-30 days.
Onion and garlic need sulphur for pungency, split nitrogen till 60 days and potash for bulb size and storage.
Thrips in dry weather; purple blotch / alternaria in humid weather.
Silvery streaks on leaves (thrips), purple spots with rings (blotch).
Heat at bulbing hastens maturity; excess rain causes rot.
Weeds hurt bulbs badly: pendimethalin pre-emergence and oxyfluorfen after transplanting.
Carrot and radish need balanced NPK at sowing and potash for root quality; avoid excess nitrogen (forking).
Aphid and leaf spots; damping off at germination.
Aphid colonies, leaf spots, forked or cracked roots (nutrition).
Heat makes roots pithy and bitter; waterlogging rots roots.
Pendimethalin pre-emergence and early thinning + weeding.
Okra needs split nitrogen, phosphorus-potash at flowering and calcium-boron for straight pods.
Jassid and whitefly (yellow vein mosaic) early; shoot and fruit borer from flowering.
Yellow vein mosaic (uproot), bored pods (fruit borer), leaf edge burn (jassid).
Heat and dry wind increase mites and flower drop.
Pendimethalin pre-emergence; hoeing at 20-25 days.
Coriander and cumin need light nitrogen, sulphur, and potash at seed filling.
Powdery mildew and wilt; blight in cumin in cloudy weather; aphid at flowering.
White powder (powdery mildew), sudden wilting, dark blight on cumin.
Cloudy humid days and frost at flowering are the main risks.
Slow early growth - pendimethalin pre-emergence and hand weeding are essential.
Ginger and turmeric need heavy organic manure, split potash and micronutrients through the long season.
Rhizome rot in waterlogged soil; shoot borer and leaf spots in monsoon.
Yellowing tillers with soft rotting base (rhizome rot) - drench and drain.
Waterlogging in monsoon is the biggest risk.
Mulch after planting; hand weeding before earthing up.
Cotton needs split nitrogen, boron and magnesium at squaring, and potash at boll development.
Sucking pests (jassid, whitefly, thrips) early; pink bollworm from flowering.
Rosette flowers and bored green bolls (pink bollworm), leaf edge burn (jassid).
Heavy rain causes square and boll shedding; dry spells increase sucking pests.
Pendimethalin pre-emergence; quizalofop for grasses; hand hoeing.
Sugarcane needs nitrogen in 3 splits up to 120 days, potash for sugar recovery, and zinc / iron on calcareous soils.
Early shoot borer in Apr-Jun, top borer in Jul-Sep, termite, red rot from infected setts.
Dead heart that pulls out (early shoot borer), bunchy top (top borer), red split cane (red rot).
Summer moisture stress at tillering and waterlogging in monsoon.
Atrazine pre-emergence; 2 4-D and hoeing up to 120 days.
Mentha needs nitrogen after each cutting and sulphur for oil.
Hairy caterpillar and termite; leaf spots in humid weather.
Skeletonised leaves (hairy caterpillar).
Heat increases oil but dry soil reduces herbage.
Pendimethalin pre-emergence and hand weeding.
Orchards need manure and NPK by tree age, zinc and boron before flowering, calcium-boron and potash for fruit quality.
Hoppers and powdery mildew at flowering (mango), scab and mites (apple), fruit fly near harvest.
Sticky honeydew on panicles (hopper), olive corky spots (scab), white powder (powdery mildew).
Fog at flowering spreads mildew; hail and wind cause fruit drop.
Keep tree basins clean with mulch; no herbicide near young trees.
Banana is a heavy potash feeder; N-K splits every month till shooting, then potash for bunch filling.
Sigatoka leaf spot in humid weather; aphid spreads bunchy top virus; root rot in waterlogging.
Streaks and spots on leaves (sigatoka) - remove infected leaves first.
Strong wind topples plants - prop them; cold stops bunch growth.
Hand weeding and mulching; intercrop in early months.
Makhana ponds need balanced NPK and organic matter; avoid excess nitrogen.
Aphid and leaf spots on floating leaves.
Aphid colonies and leaf rot on floating leaves.
Water level and heat stress affect flowering.
Remove floating weeds by hand.
